fallback_calibration.method: last-prefill control row: 357 sequential stock decode rounds

global_cutoff_oracle.model: control boundary TTFT + measured MTP component prefix + remaining longest-request rounds * fastest exact stock round; switching and endpoint overhead omitted

request_local_target_work_oracle.clairvoyant_policy: use MTP only on request-iterations whose next depth-1 draft will be accepted; use stock decode on every rejection
request_local_target_work_oracle.conclusion: At proposal depth 1, every accepted draft exchanges two target positions for two emitted tokens and every rejected draft is strictly extra work. Even future knowledge cannot reduce target positions below stock, and any realizable policy adds assistant work.
